name: Callipogon proletarius
intro: I photographed an adult in January 2026 and found hatchlings on January 30. I did not record the laying date.

facts.title: Range
facts.text: The nominate form is recorded from Puerto Rico

facts.title: Unsuccessful larval substrate
facts.text: All larvae in the oyster-kinshi group died

sections.title: Larvae
sections.text: I reared larvae on two kinds of kinshi (fungus-colonized wood). By early November the larvae on turkey-tail kinshi were growing well. All those on oyster-mushroom kinshi had died, although most of my Stenodontes exsertus larvae on the same batch survived. I would start another group on turkey-tail kinshi. I followed this brood through the feeding stage.

sources.title: Oyster and turkey-tail kinshi outcomes, November 2026 (Discord)
Western Hemisphere Cerambycidae catalog, Callipogonini (Puerto Rican nominate form)

distribution.caption: Monné lists Puerto Rico and Martinique for the nominate form and Cuba for the subspecies shulzhenkoi.
distribution.alt: Documented regions for Callipogon proletarius: Cuba, Martinique, Puerto Rico.
